title: Local Synapse Snapshots
text: snapshot selected, crant_partner_summary() crant_partners() answer queries whenever can, otherwise fall back CAVE. Use method = "local" insist snapshot, method = "cave" skip . Root ids make sense one time, analysis makes several queries fix time use throughout:
code: id <- "576460752684030043" # up to the second: edits since the newest snapshot are fetched from CAVE crant_partner_summary(id, partners = "inputs") # at a materialisation version, with no CAVE lookups crant_partner_summary(id, partners = "inputs", version = crant_version()) # individual synapses, with their positions crant_partners(id, partners = "output", method = "local") now <- Sys.time() ins <- crant_partner_summary(id, partners = "inputs", timestamp = now) outs <- crant_partner_summary(id, partners = "outputs", timestamp = now)
